about: Alex's run, 2026-10-11: decoupage maker testing the waters, sells mostly at small markets, no cards, no online presence beyond a couple of Marketplace sales.
facts: What do you make?
Decoupage bottles, trays and home decor
What do you want your making to do for you?
Bring in real money, so I can see if this could be more
Where are you right now with selling your pieces?
I've sold a few, mostly to people I know
Where have your sales come from so far?
Friends and family; Friends of friends who heard about my work; Craft shows or markets; Facebook Marketplace
Which of those has brought you the most sales?
Craft shows or markets
What kind of shows or markets have you sold at?
Small local markets; Farmers markets; Pop-up events with other makers; Holiday bazaars or church sales
Do you hand out business cards at your markets?
I don't have cards yet
If someone loves your work at a market but doesn't buy, how could they find you again later?
They couldn't, unless they asked me for my name. I have no business page, only a personal Facebook profile.
On a typical piece, about how much money is left after you pay for your supplies?
About $5 to $15. I charge about $35 for a bottle and $15 for a tray; materials are $5 to $10.
What makes your pieces different from other decoupage you see at markets?
Unique designs, no one is selling exactly what I sell. Shoppers ask how I do it and whether I take custom orders.
Where would you like most of your selling to happen down the road?
A mix of in person and online
How do you feel about shipping your pieces?
It would depend on how much it costs. I am not sure.
What would you most like to try next with your decoupage?
Get into a bigger, busier craft show; Have a place online where people can see my work. I have heard Etsy fees are high, and how do I get into local shops?
